However, the test at spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:43 sets up `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` expecting TopicRetriever to be instantiated directly in the controller. Since the controller actually enqueues a job (Jobs::RetrieveTopic) which would later call TopicRetriever, the mock expectation on TopicRetriever.new will never be satisfied during the controller action itself. This is a real test bug - the test incorrectly mocks a synchronous call when the actual implementation is asynchronous.
